Increasing passenger traffic on
Mumbai-Delhi rail link
*361. SHRI SANJA Y RAJARAM
RAUT: Will the Minister of RAILWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that passengers
travelling through Mumbai and Delhi are
increasing day by day and Railways can
not accommodate passengers demand;
(b) if so, whether Government propose
to increase the sleeper and A/C coaches for
Mumbai and Delhi bound trains; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Surveys of sanctuaries and parks
*362. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) the funds allocated for surveys of
sanctuaries and parks in 2003-2004;
(b) the quantum of funds spent for such
purposes;
(c) whether any steps would be taken
to routinely survey all wildlife parks and
sanctuaries in the country; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
National Health Policy
†*363. SHRI PY ARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that
Government’s health service, continuing
under the National Health Policy, has failed
to achieve its goals;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government in
this regard; and
(c) if not, the number of health centres
opened so far across the country under the
National Health Policy and their present
status?
Drought impact in States

  JOSHI:
SHRIMATI SAVITA
   SHARDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that more than
half of the country is facing drought due to

Special arrangement for SC
community under National Health
Policy
†*365. SHRI NARAYAN SINGH
KESRI: Will the Minister of  HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether any special arrangement has
been made for rural scheduled caste
community under National Health Policy;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, whether Government would
consider for special arrangement for crores
of the scheduled caste population in rural
areas of the country?
Rail reservation facilities
†*366. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the States having no railway
track in its vast area, will be given preference
in the expansion of rail reservation
facilities;
(b) whether all the District
Headquarters of such States will be
provided with the rail reservation facilities
during the year 2004-2005; and
(c) if so, by when all the District Head-
quarters and major cities in the States like
Uttaranchal will be provided with such rail
reservation facilities?
Shortage in fertilizer supply
*367.   SHRIMATI JAYA
BACHCHAN:
SHRI AMAR SINGH:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS
AND FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there had
been an upsurge in the sale of MOP
fertilizers during the current kharif season,
which resulted in the short fall in the supply
of fertilizers to the farmers;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps Government have taken to
meet the shortage and the results thereof?
Inviting tenders through internet
†*368. SHRIMATI SA VITA
SHARDA: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
invite tenders through internet keeping in
view the crimes being committed due to
the contractor system in railways;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when a final decision is likely to
be taken in this regard?

chemicals industry under foreign

Increasing fellowship to scholars under
ICAR
1779. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of scholars undertaking
research work under ICAR;
(b) how many of these scholars are
ladies;
(c) whether any fellowship is being paid
to the researchers;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether there is any proposal to
enhance the fellowship amount to lady
research scholars in order to motivate and
empower them further; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
 Central assistance for debt relief to
farmers
1780. SHRI N.K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of peasants who caught
in debt trap have committed suicide in
Kerala;
(b) whether Kerala Government has
sought any Central assistance for
providing relief to such farmers;
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
reaction of Government thereto; and
(d) whether Government would
consider to waive agricultural loan upto
the tune of Rs.50,000 and interest of loan,
extend moratorium for recovery of loan
announced by RBI upto three years?
 Per Capita wheat and rice availability
†1781. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any downfall in the
per capita availability of wheat and rice in
the country since beginning of 90's till
date;
(b) if so, the facts in this regard;
(c) whether it is a fact that agricultural
production has been decreasing as
compared to population growth in the
above years in the country; and

this regard and whether in the above
situation, promoting production of cash

solution of overcoming starvation related
problems?
 White paper on suicide
1782. PROF. SAIF-UD-DIN SOZ: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that during the past few years many
farmers committed suicides in different
parts of the country; and
(b) if so, whether Government would
consider to place a white paper on this
crucial issue before the House?
 Suitability of Bt. cotton
1783. DR. K. KASTURIRANGAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether systematic studies have
been conducted on different Bt. cotton
hybrids to evaluate their suitability under
Indian conditions;
(b) if so, the main conclusions of such
studies;
(c) whether such studies also address
issues of ecological consequences
including human health; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
 Permission to foreign trawlers on deep
sea fishing
1784. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have taken any
action on the representations for
withdrawing permission granted to foreign
trawlers for deep sea fishing;
(b) if so, the details of action taken;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the total number of foreign trawlers
doing fishing due to the above permission?
 Development of marine fisheries
1785. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the proposals for
development of marine fisheries are
pending with Government;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of total amount released
for above scheme during the last three years
to Karnataka, year-wise?
 Central delegation to assess drought
situation in States
†1786. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have sent
Central delegation to the different States
to assess the effect of drought there;
(b) if so, the names of the States visited
by the said delegation alongwith the dates
of their visits, separately;
(c) the report submitted by the
delegation on drought in each of the
State;
